LIN_DeOilSkin.description: Reduce excess shine in masked skin using low-frequency Lab luminance adjustment and limited highlight-core reconstruction.

image.name: image
image.tooltip: Portrait image to de-shine. The skin mask is applied to this image.

skin_mask.name: skin_mask
skin_mask.tooltip: Skin area to process. Connect the skin_mask output of Skin DeShine Mask.

strength.name: strength
strength.tooltip: Overall shine-suppression strength: 0 disables luminance reduction (highlight-core repair remains separately controlled), 1 is balanced, and higher values suppress more shine.

core_repair.name: core_repair
core_repair.tooltip: Low-frequency reconstruction of bright, nearly white highlight cores; reduce to keep more original highlights.

color_repair.name: color_repair
color_repair.tooltip: Restores skin color in highlight cores; reduce to avoid excessive color replacement.

manual_mode.name: manual_mode
manual_mode.tooltip: How to combine a manual mask: add, subtract, intersect, or replace.

manual_expand.name: manual_expand
manual_expand.tooltip: Expand the processing mask outward by this many pixels; 0 leaves it unchanged.

manual_shrink.name: manual_shrink
manual_shrink.tooltip: Contract the processing mask inward by this many pixels; 0 leaves it unchanged.

manual_blur.name: manual_blur
manual_blur.tooltip: Additional mask-edge feathering radius; 0 keeps the current edge.

manual_threshold.name: manual_threshold
manual_threshold.tooltip: Binarization threshold for hard-edged masks; 0 preserves soft edges.

manual_strength.name: manual_strength
manual_strength.tooltip: Strength of the manual-mask contribution: 1 fully applies it, 0 ignores it.

preview_opacity.name: preview_opacity
preview_opacity.tooltip: Green mask overlay opacity in the preview only; does not change processing.

manual_mask.name: manual_mask
manual_mask.tooltip: Optional externally painted or corrected mask, used with manual_mode and manual_strength.

LIN_FaceSkinMask.description: Build a face-skin mask with MediaPipe (default) or optional InsightFace, with manual refinements.

image.name: image
image.tooltip: Portrait to analyze; the largest detected face is selected.

algorithm.name: algorithm
algorithm.tooltip: Face landmark detector. MediaPipe needs its task model; InsightFace loads through the optional integration.

feature_margin.name: feature_margin
feature_margin.tooltip: Expand the protected eyes, eyebrows, and lips to exclude more nearby pixels from the skin mask.

boundary_shrink.name: boundary_shrink
boundary_shrink.tooltip: Contract the face boundary to reduce inclusion of hair, ears, and background.

edge_blur.name: edge_blur
edge_blur.tooltip: Feather the automatic mask boundary. Higher values create softer edges.

manual_mode.name: manual_mode
manual_mode.tooltip: How to combine a manual mask: add, subtract, intersect, or replace.

manual_expand.name: manual_expand
manual_expand.tooltip: Expand the merged mask outward by this many pixels; 0 leaves it unchanged.

manual_shrink.name: manual_shrink
manual_shrink.tooltip: Contract the merged mask inward by this many pixels; 0 leaves it unchanged.

manual_blur.name: manual_blur
manual_blur.tooltip: Additional feathering radius for the final mask; 0 leaves the current edge.

manual_threshold.name: manual_threshold
manual_threshold.tooltip: Binarization threshold for hard-edged masks; 0 preserves soft edges.

manual_strength.name: manual_strength
manual_strength.tooltip: Strength of the manual-mask contribution: 1 fully applies it, 0 ignores it.

preview_opacity.name: preview_opacity
preview_opacity.tooltip: Green overlay opacity in the preview; does not change the returned MASK.

manual_mask.name: manual_mask
manual_mask.tooltip: Optional external hand-painted or corrected mask.

LIN_SkinDeShineMaskLayer.description: Composite a source image over a destination for mask editing, and return the opacity-scaled mask.

destination.name: destination
destination.tooltip: Base/background image, usually the original portrait.

source.name: source
source.tooltip: Layer to insert, such as MaskToImage output or another reference image.

mask.name: mask
mask.tooltip: Where to show the source layer, usually Skin DeShine Mask's skin_mask.

mask_opacity.name: mask_opacity
mask_opacity.tooltip: Mask strength: 1 applies the full mask, 0 hides the source. Also scales the output mask.

background_opacity.name: background_opacity
background_opacity.tooltip: Source-layer opacity in the composite preview only; does not weaken the output mask.

LIN_SkinDeShineMaskEditor.description: Add to or replace an optional automatic mask using ComfyUI Painter.

image.name: image
image.tooltip: Background shown in the Painter interface.

mask.name: mask
mask.tooltip: Open ComfyUI Painter to paint or erase a mask; the edited mask is returned as MASK.

edit_mode.name: edit_mode
edit_mode.tooltip: add keeps the automatic mask and adds painted regions; replace uses only the Painter mask.

auto_mask.name: auto_mask
auto_mask.tooltip: Optional starting mask, usually the skin_mask from Skin DeShine Mask.
